title: Mechanical & HVAC
summary: Cooling, ventilation and indoor air quality systems, from supply, installation and commissioning through operation and maintenance.

groups.title: System delivery & annual contracts
items: Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of central chilled-water, VRF and packaged air-conditioning systems within the agreed project scope.
Precision air-conditioning for server rooms, control rooms and process areas.
Ventilation and smoke-exhaust design coordination, installation and approval liaison where contracted.
Annual maintenance contracts (AMC) and comprehensive annual maintenance contracts (CAMC), with system coverage and exclusions agreed in writing.

groups.title: Cooling & ventilation
items: Operation and monitoring of chillers, AHUs, FCUs, VRF/VRV systems and packaged air-conditioning units.
Cooling tower inspection, basin cleaning, water-level checks and performance monitoring.
Basement ventilation, smoke extraction, toilet exhaust fans and kitchen hood systems.
Air-filter cleaning and replacement, duct cleaning and fresh-air optimisation for indoor air quality.

groups.title: Mechanical inspections & repairs
items: Inspection of motors, compressors, pumps, chilled-water pipes, valves, strainers, insulation and flexible connections.
Refrigerant leak checks and monitoring of system pressures, temperatures and operating performance.
Lubrication of bearings and moving parts; checks of belts, pulleys, couplings, vibration and abnormal noise.
Breakdown attendance, fault diagnosis, minor repairs and approved component replacement.

groups.title: Controls & operating records
items: Inspection of thermostats, sensors, actuators and HVAC control panels.
Monitoring of BMS alarms, temperature settings and equipment operating schedules.
HVAC logs, equipment history, energy readings and preventive maintenance checklists.

groups.title: Specialist utility systems
items: Coordination of maintenance for compressed-air, steam and process cooling-water systems where installed and contracted.
Specialist coordination for PNG, LPG and HSD fuel piping within the agreed site scope.

resources: Equipment: chillers, AHUs, FCUs, VRF units, ventilation fans, pumps and motors.
Tools: pipe benders, duct cutters, hydraulic crimpers, welding and pipe-threading equipment, as required for approved work.
Instruments: anemometers, digital manometers, leak detectors and temperature/humidity data loggers.
Spares: air and HEPA filters, V-belts, bearings, thermostats, specified refrigerants, insulation, condensate pipes, seals, gland packing, couplings, vibration pads and alignment shims.
note: Specialist repairs, refrigerant work, utility piping and pump maintenance are defined and priced in the agreed scope; OEM or specialist attendance is coordinated where required.

title: Electrical & Power Systems
summary: Power distribution, backup supplies, lighting and electrical protection, from engineering and installation through testing and maintenance.

groups.title: Electrical engineering & installation
items: Substation layout, civil interfaces, utility liaison and energisation coordination.
HT/LT switchgear selection, protection coordination, settings and cable-sizing support.
Transformer and diesel-generator sizing, redundancy, synchronisation and load-transfer planning.
MCC, PCC and automatic power factor correction (APFC) panels, motor controls and metering.
Lighting design, small power, containment, equipotential bonding and surge protection, with installation and testing under the agreed package.

groups.title: Power distribution
items: Operation and monitoring of HT/LT panels, transformers, RMUs, PCCs, MCCs, main distribution boards, sub-panels and busways/bus ducts.
Inspection for overheating, abnormal noise, damage, cable termination issues, busbar condition and panel indications.
Recording of voltage, current, frequency, power factor and energy consumption.
Scheduled thermography and electrical testing under the approved maintenance plan.

groups.title: Backup & critical power
items: Inspection, operation and testing coordination for diesel generators, AMF/ATS panels, batteries and auxiliaries.
Monitoring and maintenance coordination for UPS systems, inverters, battery banks and critical power supplies.
Response to power failures, nuisance tripping, electrical faults and emergency breakdowns.
Solar power system monitoring and specialist maintenance coordination where included in the contract.

groups.title: Lighting & electrical safety
items: Internal, external and emergency lighting maintenance, including energy-efficient lighting controls.
Replacement of defective lamps, LED drivers, switches, sockets, MCBs and approved minor accessories.
Inspection of earthing connections and scheduled resistance testing of grounding systems.
Lightning protection system inspections and scheduled testing.
Electrical logs, meter readings, maintenance records and test reports.

resources: Equipment: transformers, RMUs, diesel generators, distribution boards and UPS systems.
Tools: cable-pulling winches, wire strippers, hydraulic lug crimpers, conduit benders and knockout punches.
Instruments: multimeters, clamp meters, insulation testers, earth resistance testers, lux meters and phase rotation meters.

Spares: cable lugs, ferrules, glands, insulation tape, heat-shrink sleeves, terminals, cable ties, MCBs, MCCBs, contactors, relays, fuses, indicator lamps, LED lamps/drivers, flexible wires, switches, sockets and junction boxes.
Safety equipment: insulated mats and task-appropriate electrical and arc-flash protection.
note: Solar maintenance, OEM specialist services, major spares and capital replacements are separately scoped. Switching, isolation and testing follow approved site procedures.

title: ELV & Building Automation
summary: Integrated building controls, security, data and communication systems, with design-stage interfaces and ongoing technical support.

groups.title: Smart-building integration
items: CCTV camera placement, storage sizing and retention-policy configuration against client requirements.
Access systems including boom barriers and visitor-management interfaces.
Data and fibre backbones, containment and structured-cabling testing.
Network-room racks, UPS provision, cooling interfaces and labelling standards.
BMS/IBMS points schedules, graphics, alarms, trends and operational dashboards.
Automation scheduling, interlocks, demand-based operation and fire-alarm/evacuation interfaces defined during design.

groups.title: Building management systems
items: BMS and building automation monitoring, alarm review and coordination of system faults.
Review of HVAC operating schedules, temperature settings and connected controls.
Troubleshooting coordination for sensors, actuators and building automation software interfaces.

groups.title: Security & communications
items: CCTV and access control system inspection, fault logging and specialist service coordination.
Structured cabling, intercom and public address / voice alarm (PA/VA) system support.
Coordination of interfaces between automation, fire detection, alarms and emergency communication systems.

groups.title: Technical service coordination
items: ELV/BMS technician deployment and work-order management within the agreed staffing plan.
Coordination of OEM visits, outsourced diagnostics, warranty claims and corrective actions.
Maintenance history, alarm records, service reports and closure tracking.

resources: Systems covered may include BMS controllers, CCTV, access control devices, intercoms, structured cabling and PA/VA equipment.
Diagnostic instruments, replacement parts and specialist software access are agreed for the installed systems.
note: Supported brands, software access, specialist servicing and replacement parts are confirmed against the site's asset register and contract.

title: Plumbing, PHE & Water Management
summary: Water supply, sanitation, drainage, treatment and pumping systems, from coordinated delivery to everyday facility operations.

groups.title: PHE engineering & system delivery
items: Hot/cold water distribution, insulation, pressure zoning and sanitary-fixture installation.
Soil and waste stacks, vents, traps and gravity-drainage design coordination.
External drainage networks, chambers and civic-mains connection coordination.
Roof drainage, surface run-off and recharge provisions.
WTP/STP packages, booster sets, sumps, control panels and redundancy arrangements, with installation, testing and commissioning where contracted.

groups.title: Water supply & storage
items: Operation and inspection of domestic cold/hot water supply, transfer pumps and hydro-pneumatic systems.
Inspection of overhead and underground tanks, water storage arrangements and water heaters.
Monitoring of water levels, pressure, pump operation and leakage.
Checks of valves, strainers, non-return valves, pressure gauges and pipe connections.
Coordination of scheduled water-tank cleaning and water-quality testing.

groups.title: Sanitation & drainage
items: Leak attendance for water supply, drainage and plumbing lines.
Maintenance of sinks, toilets, faucets, flush valves, showers, sensor taps and sanitary fittings.
Clearing minor blockages in traps, floor drains and accessible drainage lines.
Inspection of sewage pumps, sump pumps and drainage pumping systems.
Rainwater drainage, stormwater pumps, accessible manholes, greywater systems and rainwater harvesting structures.

groups.title: Treatment & monitoring
items: STP, ETP, filtration and water-treatment system operation, monitoring and maintenance where contracted.
Water-quality testing coordination for treatment and recycling units.
Water consumption records, pump logs, leakage reports and preventive maintenance records.

resources: Equipment: transfer pumps, submersible sewage pumps, filtration units, water heaters and hydro-pneumatic tanks.
Tools: pipe and basin wrenches, PVC/PPR fusion equipment, pipe cutters and pipe vices.
Instruments: hydraulic pressure-test pumps and drain inspection cameras.
Spares: PVC, CPVC, PPR and GI pipes, elbows, tees, reducers, sockets, end caps, ball/check/butterfly/pressure-reducing valves, faucet cartridges, flush valves and sensor taps.
Repair consumables: PTFE tape, solvent cement, silicone sealants, rubber gaskets and pipe clamps.
note: STP/ETP and pump maintenance, specialist treatment work and associated consumables are subject to a separately agreed scope and charges where applicable.

title: Fire Protection & Life Safety
summary: Fire detection, suppression and life-safety systems, with engineering, installation, testing, authority liaison and maintenance within the agreed scope.

groups.title: Fire-system engineering & delivery
items: Addressable detection panels, detector zoning and BMS/public-address interfaces.
Wet riser, hydrant and hose-reel networks, with occupancy-based system sizing.
Wet/dry sprinkler systems, hazard assessment and hydraulic calculations within the approved design scope.
Clean-agent and water-mist suppression for server, electrical-panel and kitchen risks as specified.
Extinguisher type selection, placement, refill coordination and inspection records.
Testing, witnessing and local fire-authority approval liaison within the agreed project package.

groups.title: Fire water & suppression systems
items: Inspection of main electric, diesel standby, jockey and booster pumps, fire-water tanks and pump-room conditions.
Checks of hydrants, wet risers, hose reels, landing valves, hoses and nozzles.
Inspection of sprinkler networks, deluge systems, control valves, flow switches and pressure gauges.
Clean-agent gas suppression system service coordination for server rooms, electrical rooms and other critical assets.
Fire extinguisher checks for access, seals, pressure and service validity.

groups.title: Detection, alarms & interfaces
items: Inspection of fire alarm panels, smoke/heat detectors, manual call points and sounders.
Review of system faults, isolations and alarm event logs.
Scheduled testing of emergency interfaces, cause-and-effect logic and shutdown interlocks.
Emergency exit, exit signage and fire-door functionality checks where included.

groups.title: Testing & emergency preparedness
items: Scheduled testing of pumps, alarms and protection systems under approved procedures.
Coordination of fire audits, mock drills and emergency response activities, including six-monthly mock drills where specified in the approved site plan.
Fire system impairment controls and coordination of necessary authority approvals, including CFO approvals where applicable to the site.
Equipment registers, inspection reports, test records and statutory documentation support.

resources: Equipment: fire pumps, storage tanks and specified clean-agent cylinders, including installed FM-200/Novec-type systems where applicable.
Tools: pipe grooving, welding and hole-cutting equipment and heavy-duty pipe clamps for approved work.
Instruments: hydrostatic test pumps, flow meters and fire alarm loop testers.
Spares: pendent/upright sprinklers, guards, flexible drop hoses, hose-reel seals, landing-valve washers and manual call point glass.
Extinguisher and signage items: dry-powder/CO2 extinguisher gauges, safety pins, tamper seals and emergency direction signs.
note: Testing and maintenance follow applicable local requirements, approved procedures and manufacturer recommendations. Drill frequency and required authority approvals are agreed for the facility; specialist servicing is separately defined.

title: Lifts & Vertical Transportation
summary: Maintenance coordination, specialist attendance and safe material-handling support for elevators, escalators and moving walks.

groups.title: Maintenance coordination
items: Coordination of OEM and specialist maintenance for elevators, escalators and moving walks.
Logging of faults, service attendance, equipment condition and maintenance history.
Coordination of approved inspections, corrective work and specialist diagnostics.

groups.title: Mechanical & diagnostic support
items: Approved specialist work involving brackets, guide-rail alignment, cable or belt tension, lubrication and door/panel alignment.
Electrical safety-circuit checks and controller diagnostics using compatible authorised service tools.
Hydraulic pressure measurement and checks for overheating, abnormal sound and vibration.

groups.title: Lifting & work-area safety
items: Coordination of lifting, rigging and material movement using appropriately rated equipment.
Task-specific fall protection, landing barriers, guard nets and controlled work areas.
Safe-work planning for open hoistways, elevator cars, heavy machines and escalator assemblies.

resources: Hand tools: wrench/ratchet sets, screwdrivers, pliers, alignment tools, straightedges, tension gauges, lubrication guns, door wedges and air shims.
Handling equipment: chain hoists, pulley blocks, rated wire-rope/web slings, shackles, eyebolts, hydraulic jacks/cylinders and lifting levellers.
Diagnostics: multimeters, compatible OEM controller test tools, digital hydraulic pressure gauges, infrared thermometers and sound-level meters.
PPE and barriers: full-body harnesses, lanyards, hard hats, eye protection, steel-toed boots, gloves, landing-door guard nets and safety barriers.
note: Lift and escalator maintenance is a separately scoped specialist service. Equipment access, diagnostics, parts, repair responsibilities and charges are confirmed with the approved OEM/service partner.

title: Workplace & Facility Support
summary: Coordinated workplace services, vendor management and facility administration to support safe, functional working environments.

groups.title: Soft FM & workplace operations
items: Daily, periodic and deep housekeeping cycles planned by area type.
Waste segregation, storage and authorised disposal coordination.
Mechanised cleaning, including scrubbing, facade cleaning and high-level access through appropriately equipped service teams.
Washroom consumables, sanitisation and pest-control coordination.
Manned guarding coordination, access records and patrol logs.
Horticulture, landscape care, reception and front-desk support.

groups.title: Workplace services
items: Coordination of housekeeping, security services, landscaping and facility utilities.
Space utilisation planning and workplace improvement initiatives.
Facility improvement projects that support efficiency, sustainability and occupant satisfaction.

groups.title: Vendor & commercial administration
items: Facilities-related vendor, contractor and service-provider coordination.
Facility budget monitoring, operating-cost review and resource utilisation tracking.
OEM attendance, specialist contractor management, warranty claims and outsourced testing coordination.

groups.title: Safety & operational continuity
items: Coordination of health, safety, environmental and facility compliance activities.
Support for business continuity, emergency preparedness and operational risk management.
Permit-to-work, lockout/tagout, PPE, electrical isolation and safe-work procedure coordination.
Facility records, maintenance schedules, asset inventories and workplace service reports.

resources: Site-specific staffing may include facility/operations managers, discipline leads, helpdesk, MIS/admin support, EHS and energy-monitoring roles.
Housekeeping, security, landscaping and specialist services are coordinated through the agreed delivery model.
note: Manpower, service hours, vendor responsibilities and workplace service inclusions are specified for each facility. Staffing is based on the site's needs and agreed service levels.

title: Maintenance, Assets & Technical Support
summary: A shared maintenance framework covering planned servicing, breakdown response, asset records, utilities, spares and reporting.

groups.title: Lifecycle contracts & service governance
items: Preventive, corrective and breakdown maintenance across civil/building fabric, MEP, ELV and utility systems within the agreed asset boundary.
AMC/CAMC coverage, asset warranty status, vendor attendance and contract renewal tracking.
Asset replacement forecasts and capital-budget planning support.
Response, resolution, availability, PPM completion and downtime KPIs reviewed against agreed targets.
Monthly owner reviews, transparent consumables/vendor-cost reporting and documented handovers when site teams change, where included in the contract.

groups.title: Planned & corrective maintenance
items: Daily equipment rounds, meter readings, alarm monitoring and operating-status checks.
Preventive maintenance schedules covering daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and annual tasks as applicable.
Scheduled servicing, calibration and inspections for maintainable assets.
Fault diagnosis, minor repairs, approved consumable replacement and restoration of services.
Breakdown complaint registration, prioritisation, response, escalation and closure; round-the-clock shift coverage where contracted.

groups.title: Helpdesk, assets & performance
items: Helpdesk and computerised maintenance management system (CMMS) work-order logging.
Tracking of response/restoration SLAs, maintenance history, equipment health and recurring faults.
Asset lifecycle planning, retrofit recommendations and equipment-replacement planning.
Electricity, fuel and water consumption monitoring and equipment efficiency review.
Coordination of applicable inspections, tests, licences, renewals and statutory records.

groups.title: Stores & material handling
items: Critical-spares and consumables inventory, minimum stock levels and procurement follow-up.
Materials/stock loading, unloading and handling coordination within the agreed site scope.
Stock receipt, issue, consumption and reorder tracking across HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire systems.
Coordination of task-appropriate tools, testing equipment, lifting equipment and PPE.

groups.title: Service organisation
items: Site-specific facility leadership, operations management and discipline-level technical supervision.
Helpdesk/CMMS, EHS, energy monitoring, MIS and administration support.
Deployment coordination for HVAC operators, electricians, plumbers, STP operators, fire technicians, ELV/BMS technicians, helpers and storekeepers.
In-house and specialist-partner delivery models with agreed shifts, escalation routes and accountability.

resources: Asset register: equipment identification, location, capacity and criticality.
PPM calendar: approved maintenance frequency for each maintainable asset.
Daily logs: operating status, readings, alarms and abnormalities.
Work-order register: complaint, priority, response time, actions and closure.
Breakdown reports: root cause, corrective action, downtime and recurrence.
Testing reports: HVAC, electrical, plumbing and fire-system test results.
Compliance register: applicable requirements and renewal dates.
Monthly FM report: PPM completion, breakdowns, downtime, utility use and pending issues.
Spares register: stock, consumption, reorder levels and outstanding procurement.
note: Response and restoration times, 24/7 coverage, staffing, maintenance frequencies, tools, consumables, spares and testing responsibilities are agreed in the contract. Major replacements, upgrades, modifications, statutory fees and specialist work are priced separately where applicable.
